subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Produzir apresentações e comentários apreciativos e críticos sobre livros, filmes, discos, canções, espetáculos de teatro e dança, exposições etc. (resenhas, vlogs e podcasts literários e artísticos, playlists comentadas, fanzines, e-zines etc.).

components.description_pt: Produzir comentário apreciativo e crítico sobre obra cultural em formato como resenha ou vlog
components.description_en: Produce an appreciative and critical commentary on a cultural work in a format such as a review or vlog
components.cc_component_description: Use digital tools to produce and format a piece of writing for publication

components.description_pt: Aplicar critérios avaliativos apropriados à forma cultural sendo comentada
components.description_en: Apply evaluative criteria appropriate to the cultural form being commented on
components.cc_component_description: Produce writing with development appropriate to the task, purpose, and audience

components.description_pt: Selecionar formato de publicação—resenha, podcast, playlist anotada, fanzine—adequado ao público-alvo e contexto
components.description_en: Select a publication format—review, podcast, annotated playlist, fanzine—suited to the target audience and context
components.cc_component_description: Adapt presentation style and language to suit a specific audience and purpose

cc_matches.description: Present information, findings, and supporting evidence such that listeners can follow the line of reasoning and the organization, development, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
Use technology, including the Internet, to produce and publish writing and link to and cite sources as well as to interact and collaborate with others, including linking to and citing sources.
Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
